sections.title: Updated
items: Rivals 2 GP2040 preset with new full press magnitude based on player feedback

sections.title: New
items: Fix: Active profile is no longer set to the last profile selected when saving configuration.
Feat: Add 1 button visualization to the configurator remapping page.
Feat: Add “Firmware Update” button to reboot the controller into BOOTSEL/UF2 mode.
Feat: Add Samus C-Stick mode selector in the stick configuration settings.

sections.title: Notes
items: Feat: Add BOOTSEL/UF2 reboot command for firmware updates from the configurator.
Feat: Add support for Samus C-Stick mode. Simultaneously pressing C-Up/Down and C-Left/Right will result in angled F-Smash inputs.
Fix: GP2040: Fix trigger/shoulder button handling so they don't overlap under certain circumstances.
